newsitem.title: USA: Toastmaster Q4 loss includes charge.
newsitem.headline: Toastmaster Q4 loss includes charge.

text.p: Toastmaster Inc, reporting a fourth quarter loss, said results include a previously announced one-time pretax special charge of about $7.6 million ($0.65 per share after tax) for restructuring.

The company is ceasing certain kitchen countertop appliance production at a plant in Boonville, Mo., and sourcing them to lower-cost vendors. Toastmaster also is looking at gross profit margins, product innovation, growth potential and operating and financing costs.

It said the subsequent impact of its strategic initiatives may include the disposition of certain products or segments of the company's business as well as the acquisition of complementary products or businesses.
Toastmaster on Tuesday reported a fourth-quarter loss, after the charge, of $0.35 per share compared to a year-ago profit of $0.27 per share. Sales declined to $54.4 million from $64.8 million.

The consumer products company attributed the decline in revenues to a falloff in breadmaker sales as the market matures. Revenues for environmental products, a line that is being phased out, declined 42 percent in the quarter.
